pioneers.midnightconfig.title: Pioneers Additions
pioneers.midnightconfig.DEFAULT_COLOUR.t: Players will start as this colour when they join the world.
pioneers.midnightconfig.GREEN_LIVES.tool:
Number of lives each player will have when they are Green.

Players will turn Yellow when they lose all their Green lives.
pioneers.midnightconfig.YELLOW_LIVES.too:
Number of lives each player will have when they are Yellow.

Players will turn Red when they lose all their Yellow lives.
pioneers.midnightconfig.RED_LIVES.toolti:
Number of lives each player will have when they are Red.

Players will become a Ghost when they lose all their Red lives.
pioneers.midnightconfig.LIVES_LOST_ON_DE: Number of lives the player will lose when they die.
pioneers.midnightconfig.LIVES_GAINED_ON_:
Number of lives the player will gain when they kill a player of a higher colour.

Yellow players gain this many lives when they kill a Green player.

Red players gain this many lives when they kill a Green or a Yellow player.
pioneers.midnightconfig.TERM_FOR_PLAYERS: Term used to refer to a single player in command messages etc.
Term used to refer to multiple players in command messages etc.
pioneers.midnightconfig.TERM_FOR_LIVES_S: Term used to refer to a single life in command messages etc.
pioneers.midnightconfig.TERM_FOR_LIVES_P: Term used to refer to multiple lives in command messages etc.
pioneers.midnightconfig.GREEN_GROUP_TITL: Title displayed for Green players in the lives list.
pioneers.midnightconfig.YELLOW_GROUP_TIT: Title displayed for Yellow players in the lives list.
Title displayed for Red players in the lives list.
pioneers.midnightconfig.GHOST_GROUP_TITL: Title displayed for Ghost players in the lives list.
